implementation.proof: Each short contributes exactly two equal comparison-mask bits. PopCount(mask)/2 equals the zero-bucket multiplicity. TrailingZeroCount plus removal of that two-bit lane visits every remaining coefficient once in original lane order. All bins stay 0..31. Nonaliased integer addition is identical modulo 2^32; aliasing retains original sequential feedback. Signed minimum magnitude, threshold/saturation, source buffers and unused tails are preserved.
implementation.ownership: Same 32-byte stack scratch, borrowed buffers, admission boundaries, capacities and lifetimes. No heap allocation, retained owner/cache or cancellation change. Refusal remains terminal.
